title: Flat and Ghost dimensions in tensor triangulated categories with a compact tilting generator
summary: Let $\mathcal{T}$ be a tensor triangulated category with a compact tilting generator $M$ and abelian heart $\mathcal{H}_M = M^{\bot_{\neq0}}$. We define a triangulated flat dimension $\mathrm{flatdim}_{\mathcal{T}}X$ for $X\in\mathcal{T}$, and give criteria in terms of tensor vanishing and resolutions by the class of pure quotients of $\mathrm{Add}(M)$. We further introduce $M$-ghost length and $M$-ghost dimension, and show that the global dimension of $\mathcal{H}_M$ controls the $M$-ghost length of all objects in $\mathcal{T}$, and that the $M$-ghost dimension of $\mathcal{T}$ coincides…
